verdict.rationale: Grok's built-in OAuth connectors let it reach your email, files, calendar, Google Drive, Teams and Salesforce data on demand. Custom tools and MCP connectors can also expose internal APIs and databases, so users can ask for AI analysis of their own data inside a Grok chat. Multi-agent research adds deeper, multi-step analysis. Missing for 10: no documentation of proactive or unprompted insights and suggestions surfaced from user data, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of how well it analyzes connected data.
